description: Generate a single-sign-on URL to the Text-Em-All conversations UI (open in a browser/iframe). Optionally scope it to one conversation thread by passing a toll-free textNumber + the other phoneNumber. Text-Em-All API: POST /v1/singlesignon/conversations. Returns { Url }. No account data is changed.

phoneNumber.description: A phone number that has a conversation with the text number, e.g. 9725551212.

textNumber.description: A toll-free text number on the account, e.g. 18885551234.

name: get_conversations_sso_url
title: Get a single-sign-on conversations URL
